node.label: Immigration & FRROs
node.summary: Foreigners Regional Registration Offices and the Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025.

facts.text: The law behind them: the **Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025**, which merged four older laws.
facts.plain: The law behind them: the Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025, which merged four older laws.

facts.text: The Home Ministry plans **FRROs** in every State capital by **2027**. There are now **20**, including new ones at Jaipur, Chandigarh, Guwahati, Aizawl and Amravati.

facts.text: The **Pahalgam attack** (22 April 2025, Baisaran meadow) killed 26 civilians; India responded with **Operation Sindoor** on 7 May 2025 and many Pakistani nationals were sent back via **Attari-Wagah**.
facts.plain: The Pahalgam attack (22 April 2025, Baisaran meadow) killed 26 civilians; India responded with Operation Sindoor on 7 May 2025 and many Pakistani nationals were sent back via Attari-Wagah.

facts.text: J&K and Ladakh HC sought an update on bringing back **Aasim Sajjad**, the Pakistan-born son of an Indian from Rajouri, deported after the **Pahalgam attack**; it had asked the MHA to decide his citizenship plea under **Section 5(1)(d) of the Citizenship Act, 1955**.
